findings.title: Incomplete review records pass the gate
findings.description: `work()` treats every `review_complete` value other than `True`, including a missing field, as a skipped review after an earlier fix round. If Qodo returns a matching completed session with that field omitted or malformed, no blocking findings, and green CI, the runner marks the pull request ready without establishing that Qodo deliberately skipped the head commit.

findings.title: A malformed finding location breaks the end-of-run handoff
findings.description: `sort_findings` checks only `title`, `attribution_status` and `action_level`, but `place` calls `.get` on `finding["location"]` without checking that it is an object (and `findings_text` does the same with `evidence` and each citation). `finish` calls `titles(self.flagged)` / `titles(self.dismissed)` → `place`, so if any listed finding has a location that is a string or a list, `finish` raises `AttributeError`, and `run_ticket` then sends the error only to stderr: no issue comment is written, no end label is set, and `agent-working` stays on the issue, even when the run was ready.
